name: Satyer Prohor — Profit Tracker (Daily Business Summary)

parameters.content:
## Satyer Profit Tracker — নাজিরাবাজার (সত্যের প্রহর) — INACTIVE
Daily business summary, 21:30 Asia/Dhaka (evening, after the day's posts).
Reads /agency/news-log.json + /agency/deals-log.json, counts today's and total posted items, and writes one summary line per day to /agency/profit-log.json (re-running the same day updates that day's line, it does not duplicate it). Missing log files are treated as empty — the workflow does not fail.
EARNINGS — HONEST LIMIT: Daraz has NO public affiliate earnings API. Earnings are only visible in the Daraz affiliate dashboard. This tracker logs ACTIVITY and any earnings Jony enters manually in /agency/earnings-manual.json: {"earnings": [{"date": "2026-11-10", "amount_bdt": 120, "source": "daraz"}]}. It NEVER invents earnings numbers. If nothing is entered, earnings_bdt_today is 0.
Target: $0.10/day profit (about ৳12/day at ~৳120/USD, approx). Running cost is ~$0 (Gemini free tier, n8n on Max, Facebook free), so profit = revenue once it starts. Daraz minimum payout is BDT 2,500 — commission accumulates and is paid monthly once above that.
No keys needed for this workflow. Workflow stays INACTIVE until Jony says activate.
Tag: business-auto (separate from news-auto, deals-auto and the video pipeline).
